s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 10 minutes, cool, mash with 2 tbsp mayo and a handful of cress. Spread 150g cream cheese on bread and layer with thin cucumber. Use 12 slices soft white bread in total, cut off the crusts and cut into triangles.

s.note: Sandy's audition for the role she didn't get
s.how: Roast 2 red capsicums at 220C for 30 minutes, peel and seed. Blitz with 200g feta, 150g Greek yoghurt and a pinch of chilli flakes until smooth. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and serve with seeded crackers.

m.how: Dry-brine a 1.8kg chicken overnight. Push 50g butter mixed with lemon zest and thyme under the skin. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 180C for 50 minutes, with 1kg halved potatoes in the tray. Rest 15 minutes before carving.

w.note: Julie's kitchen on a weekend off
w.how: Mix 300g self-raising flour with 200ml cream and 2 tbsp sugar to a soft dough. Pat out, cut 4 rounds and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Toss 500g sliced strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar. Whip 200ml cream softly, split the scones and fill.

d.note: lunch at the Russian Tea Room with George
d.how: Brew 4 tsp loose black tea in 1L just-boiled water for 4 minutes, strain into 4 glasses. Serve with lemon slices and a small dish of cherry jam on the side for stirring in, the Russian Tea Room way.
